portal.meaning: Lowercase DNS name used for the vhost; cannot be an IP literal.

upstream.meaning: Primary destination for proxy templates. Required for proxy if no prior upstream exists; static and PHP require no upstream.

aliases.meaning: Additional names supplied as an array of strings, comma-separated text, or iterable object keys. Empty names are skipped. Omission on a portal route keeps prior aliases, when present.

tailnet-port.meaning: Optional tailnet listener port as an integer or an unsigned decimal string in the same range; omission keeps a prior port.

locations.meaning: Additional distinct locations, as an array of location objects or text that decodes to that array.

path.meaning: Distinct location other than bare /; may be prefixed with = or ^~.

strip_authorization.meaning: Suppress the Authorization header for this location.

max-body-size.meaning: Nginx body size; omission keeps the prior setting, otherwise defaults to 1m.

read-timeout.meaning: Proxy read timeout in seconds, as an integer or unsigned decimal string in the same range. Omission keeps the prior setting or defaults to 60.

template.meaning: Template selected by the loaded Hestia seat. Omission keeps any prior template or uses the seat default when present.

cors.meaning: Hestia CORS include selected by name.

cache-static.meaning: Use the Hestia cache-static include on static or PHP templates.

root.meaning: Absolute document root required by a static or PHP template if not already held.

fpm.meaning: PHP backend, required if not already held: unix:/ with a socket path, or host:port (including bracketed IPv6) with port 1–65535.

path.meaning: Append Hestia proxied locations: location=upstream text or a location object, singly or in an array. Uses the same path and upstream rules as locations.

alias.meaning: Add local aliases to a static or PHP template: location=file text or a path/file object, singly or in an array. Both paths start with / and the location cannot duplicate another exact location.

fallback.meaning: Absolute fallback page for a static template.

certificate.meaning: Nginx-safe path to the leaf certificate. A missing or empty path selects <cert dir>/<portal>.pem.

key-path.meaning: Nginx-safe path to the leaf key, not key bytes. A missing or empty path selects <cert dir>/<portal>.key.pem.

dry-run.meaning: Render the vhost and return the planned commands without validating or reloading Nginx.

primitive.meaning: The certificate operation (apply_nginx), or error for the stop-level exception arm.

role.meaning: Normalized appliance profile used by the certificate operation.

changed.meaning: Whether the primitive reports a change; some failure paths may report partial effects.

dry_run.meaning: Whether the primitive returned a dry-run receipt; a refusal before planning can report false.

state_generation.meaning: Reported generation of the certificate state, or 0 when not available.

client_reinstall_required.meaning: Whether clients must reinstall trust for the reported operation.

portal.meaning: Portal for which Nginx was rendered.

aliases.meaning: Normalized additional names, excluding the primary name.

reloaded.meaning: Whether Nginx was reloaded with the candidate.

legacy_path.meaning: Path of the legacy vhost for this name.

legacy_present.meaning: Whether the legacy vhost was present before applying.

legacy_retired.meaning: Whether the pre-existing legacy vhost was removed.

replacement_written.meaning: Whether the candidate differs from the initial managed vhost; false in a dry run.

central_written.meaning: Shared include paths whose candidate bytes differed.

validation_output.meaning: Output at the Nginx validation boundary.

reload_output.meaning: Output of the candidate reload on success.

restored.meaning: Whether rollback reported no failed file restore.

rollback_reloaded.meaning: Whether Nginx reloaded the previous configuration.

command_output.meaning: Failure detail from the write, command or readback.

plan.meaning: Ordered action names describing the proposed operation.

commands.meaning: Planned Nginx validation and service reload argument vectors, not commands run in the plan.

hestia_seat.meaning: Whether the Hestia route grammar was available.

skipped_fields.meaning: Rendered row fields not described by the loaded Hestia seat.

served_fields.meaning: On preflight refusal, the payload field names served by this stop, including notes from the active Hestia seat.

proof.meaning: Evidence named by the primitive for this outcome.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Outcome token; none on success. Hestia also forwards the open forms unknown-field:<key>, agathodaimon-hestia-template-unknown:<value>, agathodaimon-hestia-file-absent:<key-or-path>, agathodaimon-hestia-template-hole-unfilled:<hole>, and agathodaimon-hestia-note-refused:<note> from the loaded seat or template. The enum lists fixed tokens and named note/required-hole tokens from the pinned Hestia seat, not unbounded suffixes.
